title: pilosella callimorpha subsp. cryptoschista
intro: Pilosella callimorpha subsp. cryptoschista, commonly known as False Salsify, is a plant species within the sunflower family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella callimorpha subsp. cryptoschista include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
